ruff.command: python -m ruff check <changed loading sources and guards>

diagnoses: Initial physical-time assertion used exact equality after ns-to-ps conversion; corrected the assertion to explicit numerical tolerance.
Reviewed alternative-syntax selection digester could coerce bool/fractional values into indices; load-specific strict validation added with four guards.
Legacy first-load test assumed the record had exactly six fields; retained those assertions and added compact-map/source-ID checks.
limits: Atomicity covers source preparation/conversion/acquisition and pairing/analysis-policy failures; arbitrary frontend/unexpected commit failures are not general rollback promises.
Incoming named interaction analyses during composition need explicit embedding policy and are refused; destination analyses retain existing invalidation semantics.
No source-ledger persistence/remapping qualification for session, copy/extraction, appended frames, external edits or scene merge yet.
No hard peak-memory ceiling or remote PDB-ID acquisition qualification; provider structural-attribute and cell diagnostics remain visible.
Temporary source conversions/candidates use native provider operations and allocate no dense atom-pair provenance matrix.
publication: No product commit, push, new wheel or release. Pre-existing unrelated work is preserved.
